task: Build responsive accessible pricing grid with monthly/annual toggle

evidence.observed: Inspected viewport 1440px: 3 pricing tiers aligned horizontally, contrast ratio 7.2:1, toggle switches between monthly and annual prices smoothly.
Inspected mobile viewport 375px: tiers stack cleanly without horizontal scrollbar; toggle sticky under navbar.
Ran axe-core automated audit: 0 critical, 0 serious, 0 moderate accessibility violations detected.

defects.description: Annual toggle discount badge lacked aria-label for screen readers
